title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to quickly remove Non-Alphanumeric Characters in AL
summary: The post shows how to strip non-alphanumeric characters from text in Business Central AL using the standard codeunit 47 StringConversionManagement and its RemoveNonAlphaNumericCharacters procedure. A page extension example on the Customer Card cleans the Name field in its OnBeforeValidate trigger, so only letters and digits are kept.
key_points: Use codeunit 47 StringConversionManagement and its RemoveNonAlphaNumericCharacters method to filter strings
The method leaves only letters A-Z and numbers 0-9, removing special characters, symbols, spaces, and emoji
Can be applied in page extensions using OnBeforeValidate triggers to clean data during user input
Offers a cleaner built-in solution compared to custom methods for handling non-alphanumeric character removal

quotes.text: we can use the standard codeunit 47 StringConversionManagement
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the specific built-in tool developers should use instead of creating custom solutions
